title: Eigenvector Attentional Surface

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.

Approved canonical nine-beat experience, Ordinary Abundance persistent-plane and discrete-scroll adaptation, acceptance criteria, preservation boundary, rollback unit, twenty slices, and mandatory human checkpoint.

allowedWork: One isolated framework-neutral eigenvector route, local semantic fixture and registry, nine deterministic beat endpoints, SVG and native KaTeX projection, bounded motion, discrete scroll selection, fixed transport, one prediction, scalar manipulation, searchable static transcript, exact URLs, accessibility, budgets, and checkpoint evidence.
Exact independently reversible commits with bounded Theseus context and focused verification evidence.
disallowedWork: Generic Beat, vector, matrix, layout, scrollytelling, or authoring APIs; second caller; shared visual promotion; SVD; curriculum; tutor; SRS; editor; accounts; Graph3D; Canvas; WebGL; Svelte semantic or clock authority.
Modification of user-owned economics source or generated publication, existing approved exemplar choreography, unrelated drafts, or replay-based direct restoration.
goal: Build one searchable nine-beat eigenvector experience with a persistent transformation plane, discrete scroll-selected states, bounded deterministic transitions, semantic identity across SVG and KaTeX, one prediction, scalar manipulation, and fixed alternate controls through a mandatory human checkpoint.
commitCadence: Commit each independently reversible verified slice with its completed Theseus evidence; never stage protected economics files or unrelated documents.
stopConditions: Stop if the mathematics or nonzero-eigenvector versus eigenspace distinction cannot be stated and tested exactly.
Stop if implementation requires a second clock, shared state store, generic beat or layout authority, or model-authored geometry or timing.
Stop if semantic identity must be inferred from glyph equality, KaTeX internals, DOM order, or SVG geometry.

Stop if direct restoration requires replay or if searchable static truth, accessibility, reduced motion, 390-pixel fit, or scoped route closure cannot be preserved by an independently removable correction.
Stop before modifying user-owned economics files, existing approved exemplar choreography, or unrelated drafts.
Stop at s20 for mandatory human visual and product judgment; no second caller or shared promotion is authorized.
